verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since GitHub ships Copilot cloud agents. However, nothing in the pack documents audit logs of agent sessions or actions, or attribution of agent actions to the user who triggered them. The centralized agent-sessions control page (github-docs-46) and the reviewable agent diffs and PRs (github-docs-26) are adjacent features for monitoring and steering sessions, not governance auditing with user attribution, so they earn no credit.
